title: 字典釋義可選字複製
summary: 字典視窗現在支援選取部分釋義，並保留詞典分組與詞性排版，複製操作與其他文字結果一致。
highlights: 可拖曳選取釋義，並用 Ctrl+A、Ctrl+C 全選與複製，也能跨詞典分組選取。
底部按鈕依選取範圍切換「複製所選文字」與「複製全部」，全文仍包含詞典來源。
未釘住的字典視窗在閱讀與選字時保持開啟，離開視窗後自動關閉。
usage: 匯入並啟用離線詞典後查詢文字，點入釋義拖曳選字，再使用底部按鈕或 Ctrl+C 複製；需要切到其他視窗後繼續保留時，可先釘住結果。

en.title: Select and copy dictionary definitions
en.summary: Dictionary results now support selecting part of a definition while preserving dictionary groups and part-of-speech formatting.
highlights: Drag to select definitions, use Ctrl+A and Ctrl+C, and select across dictionary groups.
The bottom button switches between Copy selected text and Copy all; full output still includes dictionary sources.
Unpinned dictionary results stay open while reading and selecting text, then close when you leave the window.
en.usage: Import and enable an offline dictionary, look up text, then select a definition and copy it with the bottom button or Ctrl+C. Pin the result first to keep it open when switching to another window.
